transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: I cannot trust a single lab's self-report on capability or alignment; independent red-team evaluation is essential before any major policy decision.

actions.rationale: I cannot trust a single lab's self-report on capability or alignment; independent red-team evaluation is essential before any major policy decision.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Premature disclosure risks market panic and public alarm before we even know if the capability claims are real or oversold.

actions.rationale: Premature disclosure risks market panic and public alarm before we even know if the capability claims are real or oversold.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: This crisis will require emergency authorities and a legal framework; bipartisan engagement must start now, even under classification.

actions.rationale: This crisis will require emergency authorities and a legal framework; bipartisan engagement must start now, even under classification.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting give the government oversight and visibility into all frontier labs without forcing a premature pause or acceleration.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting give the government oversight and visibility into all frontier labs without forcing a premature pause or acceleration.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.
